title: Soil pH kit review
body: The cheap colour kit reads 0.5 high against the lab. Fine for trend, not for liming decisions.

title: Compost thermometer week 3
body: Core at 61C on day 18, turned the pile, back to 55C by day 21. Moisture felt right.

title: Drip line pressure
body: Emitters past the 30 m mark starve at 1 bar. A second feed from the far end fixed it.

title: First frost dates
body: Ten years of first frost: median Oct 24, earliest Oct 9. Cover beds by Oct 15.

title: Rain barrel overflow
body: Overflow into the swale, not the path. Added a 50 mm elbow and a leaf screen.
